Included in the $249/month package

Small business website design.
Built around your work.

We design and build websites for small businesses across the United States. Your 10–20 pages explain your services, answer customer questions, and make it easy to contact you from a phone or computer.

Talk about your business

The pages your customers actually need.

A homepage gives people their bearings. Dedicated service pages explain the work. Photos show the details. Useful FAQs answer common questions, and clear contact options help visitors take the next step. We plan those pages together instead of asking you to decide everything on your own.

A design that fits your business.

A roofer, a restaurant, and a Pilates studio need different things from a website. The structure, photography, wording, and contact flow should reflect the customer’s reason for visiting. The five full examples show how that changes from one business to another.

Built for a phone, too.

Customers may be checking your business between other tasks. Readable text, fast-loading images, clear navigation, and easy-to-use forms help them find the information they need on a smaller screen.

Start with the information you know.

Bring your current website if you have one, your main services, the places you serve, and photographs you have permission to use. We discuss who supplies or approves the wording, how visitors should contact you, and which existing pages need to be preserved. The page plan and any special functions are agreed before the build.

What’s included

  • 10–20 pages, planned around your business
  • Clear service pages and inquiry forms
  • Designed for phones, tablets, and computers

A homeowner visits your plumbing website, opens the water-heater page, checks the information, and requests a visit without searching through unrelated services.

Your questions,
answered.

What pages should a small business website include?

Start with a homepage, dedicated pages for your main services, an about page, contact options, and answers to common questions. Photos, project examples, and useful service-area information can help customers decide. We plan the 10–20 pages around what your business actually offers.

Can you redesign a website I already have?

Yes. We review the existing pages, useful content, and inquiry paths before planning a redesign. Share the current address and any pages that already bring relevant inquiries so their content and URL changes can be considered before launch.

Is website design included in the $249 monthly package?

Yes. A 10–20 page business website is included with inquiry follow-up, missed-call text replies, review requests, and on-page SEO. Setup fees, ownership, minimum terms, hosting, maintenance, and any additional costs are confirmed before you agree.
